import json,hashlib,math,csv
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np,torch
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score,average_precision_score
d=torch.load('artifacts/data/shapeggen.pt',map_location='cpu',weights_only=False)
pairs=list(map(tuple,d.edge_index.T.tolist()));ps=set(pairs)
out={'graph':{'directed_entries':len(pairs),'loops':sum(a==b for a,b in pairs),'duplicates':len(pairs)-len(ps),'reciprocal':all((b,a) in ps for a,b in pairs)},'masks':{},'hashes':{}}
for bb in ['gcn','graphsage']:
 rows=list(csv.DictReader(open(f'results/metrics/shapeggen/{bb}/pgexplainer/per_node_metrics.csv')));allq=[];records=[]
 for row in rows:
  t=int(row['node_id']);p=Path(f'results/explanations/shapeggen/{bb}/pgexplainer/seed_42/node_{t}/edge_mask.pt')
  out['hashes'][str(p.resolve()).replace('//','/')]=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
  q=torch.load(p,map_location='cpu',weights_only=False);c=d.candidate_edge_mask[t].bool().numpy();y=d.edge_mask[t].bool().numpy()[c];q=q.numpy()[c].astype(float);allq.extend(q.tolist())
  auc=roc_auc_score(y,q);ap=average_precision_score(y,q);k=max(1,math.ceil(.2*len(q)));s=np.sort(q)[::-1]
  records.append({'node_id':t,'label':int(row['label']),'n':len(q),'gt_n':int(y.sum()),'auroc':auc,'ap':ap,'gt_mean':float(q[y].mean()),'nongt_mean':float(q[~y].mean()),'gap':float(q[y].mean()-q[~y].mean()),'distinct':len(np.unique(q)),'cutoff_tie':bool(s[k-1]==s[k]) if k<len(q) else False,'max':float(q.max()),'zero_n':int(sum(q==0)),'official_delta':max(abs(auc-float(row['edge_auroc'])),abs(ap-float(row['edge_ap'])))})
 q=np.array(allq);out['masks'][bb]={'n':len(q),'targets':len(records),'min':float(q.min()),'max':float(q.max()),'mean':float(q.mean()),'median':float(np.median(q)),'std':float(q.std()),'quantiles':dict(zip(['p01','p05','p25','p75','p95','p99'],map(float,np.quantile(q,[.01,.05,.25,.75,.95,.99])))),'below_01':int(sum(q<.01)),'below_001':int(sum(q<.001)),'zero':int(sum(q==0)),'one':int(sum(q==1)),'constant_targets':sum(x['distinct']==1 for x in records),'cutoff_ties':sum(x['cutoff_tie'] for x in records),'all_below_01_targets':sum(x['max']<.01 for x in records),'auroc_below_half':sum(x['auroc']<.5 for x in records),'negative_gt_gap':sum(x['gap']<0 for x in records),'max_official_delta':max(x['official_delta'] for x in records),'records':records}
print(json.dumps(out))
